title: Dashboard TUI cosmetic defects: header spams bare "Loop" per tick + Recent labels DONE stories "incomplete"
description: Two cosmetic defects in the cam dashboard TUI render layer, observed live during the CAM-64 implement loop (branch cam/issue-64, 2026-07-17). (1) Header/output pane spam: the top output pane renders the bare word "Loop" repeated once per tick, filling dozens of lines with zero signal; expected a meaningful per-tick line or no repeated Loop noise. (2) Recent event feed mislabels completed stories as "incomplete": the Recent section shows US-005/US-004/US-003 incomplete etc. for stories the Stories panel simultaneously shows checked (DONE); the outcome->label mapping in the dashboard event log is wrong for the story-completion event. Both are display-only (no effect on the loop, which drove all 6 CAM-64 stories green). Likely same render layer / possibly one root cause; spec may split if roots diverge.
